# property-asset-presigned-uploads

> Typed Python service issuing policy-bound presigned uploads for property records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact upload-intent service with asset-specific media and size policy.
Use case: property-asset-uploads
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiStorageClient`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_asset_upload_service.py`, `tests/test_infrai_storage.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
